corrections.trigger: fix1/fix2 published the retry handoff after calling emit(response.failed) without proving that the bridge accepted the failure frame; a closed or failed controller could therefore authorize a successor without delivered failure. The non-streaming path also published before final response construction.
corrections.change: Make bridge emit return its enqueue result and publish the retry handoff only after a successful response.failed enqueue; in non-streaming mode build the final response JSON before publishing the handoff.

notes: Current source and direct caller contracts were manually reviewed; normal success, retryable failure, cancellation, queue overflow, and iterator cleanup paths remain reachable by source inspection.
Queue limits remain based on currently queued bytes and release/reset on dequeue/cancellation; no queue change was made in wave 3.
No tests, typechecks, scripts, broad audits, runtime/app starts, commits, push, or delegation were performed.
Connector identities and public ABI remain unchanged; parent-reserved test and diagnostic files were not edited.
